description: One site's plan from its latest check: why each AI does or doesn't name it (in plain words, from the real answers) and the moves, ranked by how many questions and AIs each can win, with the rivals each move beats and the pages the AIs read instead. Use it for "what should I improve first on biotree.bio?". To hand a move to a coding session, use build_prompt; when it has shipped, mark_move_done.

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

name: action_plan

date.description: The check the plan comes from.

locked.description: True on a free site: move 1 in full, the rest locked.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

moves.description: { id, rank, kind, title, locked, detail, impact, targets, rival, evidence, hasBuildPrompt, done }.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).

title: What to improve
